convert_FastSpeech2ConformerModel_checkp: convert an Espnet FastSpeech2Conformer checkpoint to HuggingFace PyTorch format with YAML config and output path
remap_model_yaml_config: remap an Espnet YAML config to HuggingFace FastSpeech2Conformer config and return tokenizer name and vocab
convert_espnet_state_dict_to_hf: convert Espnet state dict keys to HuggingFace FastSpeech2Conformer model key names
run_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert a FastSpeech2Conformer checkpoint from Espnet to HuggingFace format
push_converted_model_to_hub: push the converted FastSpeech2Conformer model and tokenizer to the HuggingFace hub by repo id
